providers.name: Graphify
providers.usage_note: 标准 Runtime Setup（或高级子集 `spec-mcp-setup --only graphify`）会安装 Graphify CLI 与当前 host 的 project skill，并从原始 PATH 或 Provider 标准用户工具路径解析 `graphify`。若 project root 尚无 Graphify artifact，它先尝试 first-generation `graphify extract .`；semantic extract 无法运行时，回退到 code-only/incremental `graphify update .`，在 project root 生成 provider-native `.graphify/`。Bare Runtime Setup 默认完成 Graphify install-init 与 query/hook verification。若 `.graphify/graph.json` 或 `.graphify/GRAPH_REPORT.md` 已存在，显式 setup 会验证或修复 install state（project skill/instruction、query probe、hook status/install），并建议显式 incremental `--refresh`，不会默认重新生成。现有旧版 `graphify-out/` artifact 只作为 compatibility 与 refresh-needed evidence；运行 `spec-mcp-setup --only graphify --refresh` 可重新生成 provider-native `.graphify/`。显式 refresh 运行 `graphify update .`（code-only，不做 LLM semantic extraction）；仅当 Graphify 拒绝覆盖并建议 `--force` 时，才执行一次 bounded `graphify update . --force` 修复。需要且目标是 git repo 时，随后启用 provider-native `graphify hook install`。若解析到的 Graphify CLI 不在原始 PATH，setup 可在 Graphify 安装的 hook 文件中加入带 marker 的 project-local PATH repair block，再验证 hook status。下游只要求 CLI/project skill/hook；Graphify MCP/watch 在 Runtime Setup 外仍保持 opt-in。使用 `$graphify .`/`/graphify .` 或解析后的 Graphify CLI query/path/explain 获取 project-graph candidate，再由 source/test/log evidence 确认结论。

safety.install_effect: Installs npm package `{{package}}@{{version}}`, resolves `graphify` from the user's original PATH or npm global bin, and verifies the resolved CLI. After npm install or upgrade, setup may back up and repoint a stale `graphify` symlink on the original PATH to the pinned executable; ordinary files, non-writable paths, and ambiguous cases stay report-only. Explicit Graphify setup verifies or installs the current-host project skill such as `graphify install --project --platform codex`, normalizes the provider-written `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` `## graphify` instruction section to resolved CLI/manual-visibility/direct-source-fallback wording, and only generates provider-native project-root `.graphify/` when no existing current Graphify artifact is present. Bare Runtime Setup includes Graphify install-init and query/hook verification by default. Existing `.graphify/graph.json`/`GRAPH_REPORT.md` triggers install-state verification plus query/hook probes and reports an explicit incremental refresh next action instead of regenerating by default. Legacy `graphify-out/graph.json`/`GRAPH_REPORT.md` is detected as compatibility-only refresh-needed evidence and does not replace the current `.graphify/` contract. Explicit refresh runs provider-native `graphify update .` (code-only, no LLM semantic extraction), with one bounded `graphify update . --force` repair only after Graphify emits overwrite refusal plus a force hint. Setup probes query/hook commands through the resolved CLI, installs project-level `graphify hook install` in git repos when needed, and may add a marked project-local PATH repair block to Graphify-installed hook files before `graphify hook status` when the resolved CLI is off the original PATH. Provider writes may include `.codex/skills/graphify/`, `.codex/hooks.json`, `AGENTS.md`, `.claude/skills/graphify/`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.graphify/`, legacy `graphify-out/`, and `.git/hooks/*`; setup reports them as provider-owned runtime/project output, does not edit shell profiles, does not vendor the Graphify skill, and does not auto-add, auto-commit, or promote provider output to spec-first source.
